findings.body: [Testing] The JAX-RS 1.0 entries immediately above still do not collect the controller-disabled default profile: `jaxrs-1.0-annotations/javaagent/build.gradle.kts:35-42` applies the controller flag and matching label to every `Test` task. That conflicts with this PR's stated goal and #20546's requirement that baseline suites use instrumentation defaults. Please split that module into an unlabeled default `test` and a separately labeled controller-telemetry variant, then register the variant here as done for 2.0/3.0.

[Testing] `jaxrs-3.0-resteasy-6.0` below remains unsplit: its `build.gradle.kts:42-47` enables and labels controller telemetry for every test, so the collection list still has no controller-disabled default profile for this JAX-RS module. This contradicts the PR description and #20546's baseline-default requirement. Give RESTEasy 6.0 the same default/controller/experimental task split and register the controller variant here.
